authorises: INSPECTION of a TECHNICAL REPEAT of the Qwen3 reserved split, for the sole purpose of estimating run-to-run variance.
binding_limits: The original run out/reserved_qwen3 remains the sole basis of every published estimate. This repeat does not supersede, replace, average with, or pool with it.
This repeat may not be used to revise, improve or restate any published number, in either direction.
Its only sanctioned use is estimating run-to-run variance and reporting it as a declared limitation.
Having two runs must not become a choice between two runs.
authority_chain: Delegated inspection authorisation for the Qwen3 reserved split, 19 August 2026 (SIG-reserved-qwen3-inspection-2026-08-19-001) - those outcomes are already open, so this repeat exposes nothing that was sealed
Pre-registration of 20 August 2026, written and hashed before the run was launched
Instruction of 20 August 2026 by the run operator: launch the repeat with the pre-registration

signature.capacity: run operator, signing on the delegated instruction of the project decision owner
signature.statement: I authorise inspection of this technical repeat for variance estimation only, under the binding limits of the pre-registration.

what_this_record_is_not: It is not the project decision owner's own signature.
It is not a second confirmatory run and creates no claim.
It does not alter any analysis parameter.
